## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at 77, rue de Varenne. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Musée Rodin.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Indulge in a captivating journey through the artistic legacy of one of the greatest sculptors in history with an entrance ticket to the Rodin Museum.
>
> Annually drawing over 700,000 enthusiasts, this cultural haven stands testament to Auguste Rodin's enduring popularity. The sculptor's foresight in dedicating a significant portion of his life's work to establish a museum in his honor has resulted in a mesmerizing collection that continues to captivate audiences worldwide.
>
> The entrance ticket opens the doors to a world where Rodin's famed sculptures come to life in their original glory. Marvel at the exquisite craftsmanship and profound artistic expression encapsulated in iconic masterpieces such as "The Thinker," "The Kiss," and "The Gates of Hell." The museum offers a unique opportunity to witness the original casts of these timeless works, allowing visitors to immerse themselves in the genius and creativity of the master sculptor.
